page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.14xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. Built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, the instance provides 56 dedicated vCPUs and 480.0 GB of system memory, resulting in an allocation ratio of 8.57 GB per vCPU. The instance is provisioned with a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The configuration does not include GPUs or bundled local storage, requiring network-attached block storage for file systems and persistence.

The hardware configuration features an approximate 1:8.5 core-to-memory ratio, catering specifically to memory capacity requirements over compute density. Because no local storage or accelerators are integrated, infrastructure costs are focused directly on CPU and RAM allocation without overhead for unneeded physical drives or auxiliary processing hardware. A notable architectural consideration is reliance on remote network storage for all disk I/O, meaning disk-heavy workflows must operate over the instance's network interfaces.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.14xlarge is structured for enterprise workloads with large in-memory working sets. Suitable use cases include in-memory databases, large-scale distributed caching services, high-throughput enterprise resource planning software, and big data ETL processing pipelines that benefit from keeping extensive data in volatile memory.
